notes.title: 1.0 LAUNCH Today!
notes.content:
New features and tons of Bug Fixes!

For those curious about what is in version 1.0, here are the notes from the STEAM Store:
[list]
[*] New Items in the SLIME store required to Exorcise the demons.
[*] All the Demons now have summoning scrolls that must be found to perform an Exorcism. Once found, Conrad creates a display in the museum to showcase these demonic parchments.
[*] The summoning scrolls are used during exorcisms to summon, ensnare, and ultimately expel the Demon from the mortal realm back to hell.
[*] The summoning scrolls have mysterious runes and letters inscribed on them. With the scrolls equipped Conrad must search the locations to find the corresponding Runes, ultimately revealing the Demon’s name, which is critical to gain control over the Demon and send it back to Hell.
[*] Exorcise the Demons of New Eidolon back to hell and finally remove all the entities haunting the available locations.
[/list]

There will also be an AMA (Ask me Anything) in my Discord this Friday at 5:00 PM EST
I will be celebrating the long path to full release and talking with the community
[url=https://discord.gg/JCKKn3qsU2]Click here to go to Discord[/url]

notes.title: Conrad Stevenson’s Paranormal P.I. is out of Early Access on SEP 29th.
notes.content:
- New Items in the SLIME store required to Exorcise the demons.

- All the Demons now have summoning scrolls that must be found to perform an Exorcism.  Once found, Conrad creates a display in the museum to showcase these demonic parchments.

- The summoning scrolls are used during exorcisms to summon, ensnare, and ultimately expel the Demon from the mortal realm back to hell.

- The summoning scrolls have mysterious runes and letters inscribed on them.  With the scrolls equipped Conrad must search the locations to find the corresponding Runes, ultimately revealing the Demon’s name, which is critical to gain control over the Demon and send it back to Hell.

- Exorcise the Demons of New Eidolon back to hell and finally remove all the entities haunting the available locations.

notes.content:
[b]*IMPORTANT*[/b]  If you continue a game, please go to the S.L.I.M.E. store and click the “owned” button on the equipment you already own to override the save structure.  If you do not do this, your base equipment will not show up.  Then immediately quit to menu and immediately continue your game.  This will place your core gear on the table in the office.  Some folks had to do this a few times to overwrite the save structure correctly.
All newly purchased equipment will NOT show up in the office immediately. It will be available in the truck at the start of a new investigation.  When you return to the office it will be on the table by the map.

notes.title: Short Term Goals for Upcoming Patches (Phase Three Update)
notes.content:
I wanted to give an update on Phase Three.   The Relics (or Trigger Objects) are in development but have been moved to a later phase.  Instead, once this phase is completed, I will begin focusing on Equipment.  I have already begun developing several pieces of equipment and am excited how this will change and enhance gameplay.

Once the equipment updates have been integrated, I will pick up where I left off on the relic system.

Just like the previous phases, I greatly appreciate everyone’s feedback.  It helped shape the final outcome of phase two.

Thank you for being here.

•	Finalize The Church on Spruce Street (4 more ghosts are planned). (Finished Dec 9)
•	Implement and complete House on Jefferson St. (Finished Jan 10)
•	Implement The New Eidolon Lighthouse location. (Finished Apri 20)
•	Provide the Demon with a home since he was evicted from Evergreen Ln. (Finished Nov 8)
•	Identify and implement optimization opportunities. (Updated Jan 10)
•	[strike]Develop and Implement Relic and Ghost Event system.[/strike] (Updated Nov 27) (Move Relic to later phase)
•	Develop and Implement Equipment System. (Finished Feb 16)
•	Continue to develop quality of life improvements. (Updated Jan 25)

Community feedback is encouraged!

Of course, there have been other very individualized issues and those are just as important to resolve.  We will get to those.

Again, thank you all for your amazing support!

notes.title: Patch 0.02.009 is live. The research system is available.
notes.content:
This is a significant update where many things have changed and to ensure you get the most out of this, I would encourage everyone to[b] start a new game[/b].  I hope everyone loves the new changes!  There was a tremendous amount of work put into this over the last month.

Just to give everyone a snippet of advice.  Gold trophies may be difficult to get the first time at a location.  As you collect specific evidence for a ghost or collect pickups, you may be able to take better notes on a particular ghost.  Your investigations will be much easier by having more notes on a specific ghost.  If you find yourself struggling to get evidence or the ghosts are being stubborn, feel free to conclude your investigation, reorganize your notes, and come back another night.

About pickups…
Pickups are items that you will find at locations and will go directly into your archives.  They will give you more information about what happened at the location, facilitating better notes.  You may have to return several times and collect a bit of paranormal evidence to gain enough information, allowing you to find a particular pickup.

-	Corrected notes text if you collected 3 EVPs.

-	Audio player allows player to replay audio captured during the investigation back at the office.

-	Locations on the interactive map will only be available to investigate after the player has reviewed the client's email on that location.
-	Hud Text size increased.
-	All the ghosts per location now are spawned at the same time.
-	Player can crouch to facilitate picking up items.

notes.title: Patch 0.01.014 is available
notes.content:
- Blue light on EMF meter was corrected.
- Revised ghosts scoring system (player still only sees gold, silver, and/or bronze) and implemented player reputation score (behind the scenes for now, used to unlock locations and maybe other things…).
	All ghosts have a base stat system.  Depending on the ghost and its behaviors, these stats will vary.  Similar to an RPG like Strength and Intelligence vs Warriors and Wizards.  Collecting evidence will excite all ghost and evidence modifiers are applied accordingly. Also, how evidence modifiers are applied vary between ghost and their alleged personalities.
-	Implemented new ghost behavior system for all ghost types.  (After this update, this change will not take effect until a new mission is started).
-	Revised Notes menu to compliment the scoring system.  Also, eliminated ghost type info from "notes" and modified descriptions to the ghost book.  This is to not clutter up the notes page but allows the player to review the Ghost book to gain an understanding of how to hunt each ghost.
-	Revised the Ghost Book to give better clues about how to investigate the different types of ghosts.  More diversity is present between ghost now.
-	Change temp sensor so it turns on as soon as it's equipped
-	Modified EVP system. Greater likelihood of obtaining them.
